From: Harry Zeliff <zeliffh@gmail.com>
Sent: Wednesday, August 19, 2020 9:58 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Thank you 
 
Dear Mr. Fenech,

I  lived in Michigan and subscribed to the Free Press for forty plus years prior to moving to Florida full time last year.  I only follow the freep news feed now and somehow missed your transfer from the Tiger beat to general news.  So when the MLB season started and there was never a column from you, I was concerned.  Concerned enough to google your name and find you still at the freep.  The Bashara article is the first item of general news that I have seen with your byline.  I am glad to see it and to take the occasion to thank you for all the fine writing you have done over the years about my (yes, my) Tigers.

I will confess to an additional interest.  Back at the dawn of time when I was at U of M law, I had a classmate, Joe Fenech, a great guy and a very good writer (and poet).  Any relation? If so, say hi to Joe for me.  And thank you again for all the great reporting on the Tigers in the past and on the metro area in the future.
Yours truly,
Harry Zeliff

Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech

From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Monday, November 17, 2014 12:53 AM
To: Collins, Terrance
Subject: Thank you 
 
Hey Terrance,
It’s Anthony. Just dropping you a note to thank you for all the help you gave me early in my career.
John recently retired and I’m the Tigers beat writer now. Been a long three years working the overnight shift (which is where I’m writing to you from).
But again, I wouldn’t be here if it wasn’t for you giving me a lot of opportunities when I was on the prep crew so thank you, I appreciate it.
Hope all is well with you and your family.
Anthony
